stem: Two flower samples differ visibly in glandular-trichome density. Which statement is scientifically defensible from visual inspection alone?
choices: The samples differ in visible trichome morphology or abundance, but cannabinoid concentration requires validated chemical measurement
The sample with more visible trichomes has a known higher THC percentage
The sample with fewer visible trichomes contains no cannabinoids
Visible trichome color establishes exact harvest chemistry
rationale: Glandular trichomes are metabolite-producing structures, but visual abundance or color is not a quantitative chemical assay and should not be converted into an exact potency conclusion.
